message: ライバルとリサイクル

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, do you have anywhere in mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Right now, maybe Ponpoko?」

name: Ria
message: 「A tanuki shop?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A thrift shop. Though, well, it's mostly just junk.」

name: Misa
message: 「That won't do at all! We need to find things that customers will actually want.」

name: Ria
message: 「What kind of things would they want?」

name: Misa
message: 「Please leave this to me.」
Misa puffs out her chest and says.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we have Misa escort us?」

name: Misa
message: 「First, right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」
It's Capricore, the high-end supermarket we came to before when shopping for the mixer.
The high-end supermarket in the Ryuusei Town shopping district, Capricore.
Compared to Inamiya, the supermarket I usually shop at, the prices are in a whole different league.

name: Misa
message: 「I'll go ask if they have any unwanted items.」

name: Ria
message: 「Can I come too?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just having you by my side, Big Sister, makes me...\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to go too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't get lost, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right. I'll...」

name: Misa
message: 「Going in with such a big group would just be a nuisance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk... You've got a point.」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, your knees are shaking.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, I'm off. Make sure you keep a good eye on the handcart.」
The three of them disappeared beyond the automatic doors.

name: Nanaka
message: 「How pathetic, honestly!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm ashamed of myself...」
However, they returned before long.

name: Synn
message: 「Cardboard boxes?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh, these are our spoils from here!」

name: Ria
message: 「They said inventory is managed by headquarters, so they can't just give it away on their own」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Plus, since they mostly sell perishable foods, anything close to its expiration date gets thrown out, apparently」

name: Synn
message: 「What a waste...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you brought back cardboard boxes instead」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She said she couldn't bear to come back empty-handed」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh! These look pretty sturdy~ And clean, too」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't settle for just this! Next time I'll definitely get something wonderful」
The next place they headed to was 'Raffine,' a shop dealing in luxury interior goods.

name: Misa
message: 「A place like this should have plenty of everyday items. Besides, it's independently owned」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't wanna look at the price tags...」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? We're only going to collect unwanted items, so the price tags don't matter」

name: Synn
message: 「R-right! A-alright... This time I'll do my part too...!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll stay behind. If I go in, I'll probably end up wanting all sorts of things」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leaving Ria-chan behind to go in seems kinda wrong to me」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll watch the handcart」

name: Misa
message: 「Count on you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds fun! I'm gonna go check it out!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Needless to say, that goes for me too~」
Chatting cheerfully, they disappeared inside the shop.

name: Ria
message: 「You don't have to hold back--you should've gone with them」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm actually relieved I had an excuse to watch the place」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Help us out here!」

name: Synn
message: 「All of a sudden!?」

name: Natalie
message: 「Come now, there's no need to be so modest」

name: Misa
message: 「No! We cannot possibly accept this」

name: Natalie
message: 「You don't like it, I see. All right then, how about this statue instead?」

name: Misa
message: 「That isn't the issue--」

name: Synn
message: 「What's going on, Misa」

name: Natalie
message: 「Oh my, Synn. Welcome~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Natalie. We're here collecting unwanted items for the Charity Bazaar」

name: Natalie
message: 「Yes, I heard all about it. And yet Misa here is telling me she doesn't want any of my shop's merchandise~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Come on, you shouldn't be picky」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not! That's not it--what she's giving us is way too bad!」

name: Synn
message: 「Luxury is the enemy, you know~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, take a look at the price tag」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands... uh-huh」

name: Synn
message: 「--Gasp!? We can't take something like this! It's supposed to be for a Charity Bazaar」

name: Natalie
message: 「That's exactly why, ex-act-ly\s04 Here, take this and this along with it!」
The generous Natalie finally even started pulling merchandise right off the display shelves.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, no. We can't accept these」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Not some little figurine like this--it has to be something far more fabulous!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, cut that out!」

name: Natalie
message: 「My, you have a discerning eye, young lady! Hold on just a moment!」
Natalie went excitedly back into the rear room.
What is she planning to bring out this time?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Roro-chan, what have you done...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you wish to obtain what you desire, you must not compromise.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, well, saying that based on your own subjective taste doesn't really help.」

name: Misa
message: 「What should we do? It's true that something we'd actually want is good, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「We can't accept this much, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's do this.」
Everyone gathers in a circle to hatch a plan.

name: Natalie
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~♪ You're def-initely going to love it this time\s04」
What she pulls out full of confidence is a cute mechanical clock.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's utterly wonderful~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, as for the price we're all wondering about--」

name: Misa
message: 「We're deliberately not looking!」

name: Ria
message: 「Shouldn't this one be fine?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I think so.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then, Natalie-san. Could we take \{just|\s12\s12} this one?」

name: Natalie
message: 「Huh? You can take the others too, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. We are very grateful for that, it's just that having too many overly expensive things would make us worry about keeping them safe...」

name: Natalie
message: 「True, it would be awful if a burglar came after them, wouldn't it? Well, if that's the case, it can't be helped.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When something is this wonderful, just a single one is more than enough.」

name: Natalie
message: 「Oh, really? I'm glad you like it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Natalie-san. Thank you very much for your cooperation!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... That still feels so half-hearted...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine. It's not like we told a lie or anything.」

name: Misa
message: 「To begin with, if I had to lie about it, I'd just take everything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly a case of 'a white \{dialect|\s12\s12}' as they say.」

name: Ria
message: 「Since it's a special charity event, we want people to feel good about participating.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's a limit to just going along with the flow, huh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though in the end, all we got were a trick clock and a cardboard box.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where to next?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are we calling it quits?」

name: Misa
message: 「No! No we're not! We're just getting started!」

name: Girl
message: 「Ho-ho-ho. Little missy over there, you sure look like you're wanting something~」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Girl
message: 「Step right up, take a gander!」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Look. Next up is right here, right here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-A street stall is pretty rare.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What kind of stuff are they selling~?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks so fun~!」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew... I managed to play it off.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't fool my eyes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, little miss?」

name: Sally
message: 「Call me Sally!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. We're looking for items to sell at our academy's Charity Bazaar, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's this firecracker?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa there, that baby's a top-notch piece that lays down smoke and lets you bolt at three thousand miles an hour!」

name: Ria
message: 「And this fluffy ride is...」

name: Sally
message: 「A custom-modded piece I just got in stock! Pedal it and it generates electricity--an ecological and economical masterpiece!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a huge fork~」

name: Sally
message: 「This is a dinner set favored by top-class demons! Is it French today? Or maybe Italian? Don't mind the lack of MP, that's part of its charm!」
Hmm...? Did I just hear something I really can't let slide?

name: Misa
message: 「Every single one of these... How utterly useless can they be?」

name: Sally
message: 「Did you say something!?」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way I could put things like this in the bazaar」

name: Sally
message: 「What's that supposed to mean? You think you can just browse around and walk away!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Unfortunately, we don't need them」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm not doing this for fun either, you know. This is business. I'm definitely not letting you get away until we strike a deal!」

name: Misa
message: 「Trying to charge money for this is practically a scam!」

name: Sally
message: 「Money...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, hold on. Paying money just to collect donations defeats the whole purpose」

name: Misa
message: 「I already know that!」

name: Sally
message: 「Trying to get your hands on the latest Demon World Mail-Order goods for free--what a bunch of nerve!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. Maybe I didn't explain enough, we're with the Ryuusei Academy Student Council and――」

name: Sally
message: 「Student... Council...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're collecting unwanted items for the Charity Bazaar at the end of this month」

name: Sally
message: 「Student Council, Student Council... Feel like I've heard that somewhere before...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry. The moment we have to pay money, we just can't ask you for it」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't need any money! Instead, treat me to a beef bowl!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can make it if you're fine without the beef...」

name: Sally
message: 「Not an onion bowl, a beef bowl!」

name: Synn
message: 「Grrr... Fine, let's call it a deal with extra green onions」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't push yourself」

name: Misa
message: 「Either way, I'd still be paying out of my own pocket. Negotiations have broken down.」

name: Sally
message: 「No, no! I wanna eat a beef bowl, I wa-n-na ea-t o-ne!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you want to eat one that badly, why don't you just go buy it yourself?」

name: Sally
message: 「If I could buy it, I would've done that from the start! For an angel, you can't even figure that out?! What a dummy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-Angels are not dummie~~s!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, that's just how it is.」

name: Sally
message: 「Buy it for me! If you don't, I won't let you go home!」
She latches tightly onto Misa's waist and refuses to let go.

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph.」
Ignoring her, Misa turns on her heel and marches briskly forward.

name: Sally
message: 「Ow, ow! Don't drag me!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't have any more time. Let go of me.」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr. If it's come to this, time for my trump card!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, st-stop it, ngh, kh, that tickles, hyah, not there, aah, hahaha, stop!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, you shouldn't do that out in the middle of the street... ba-dump\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just watch, hyaah, wh-wh, eek, aah, nngh, do something, hih, about this girl!」
I pin down the arms of the tantrum-throwing Sally-chan and pull her away from Misa.

name: Sally
message: 「Where do you think you're touching, pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「There isn't even anything there to touch...」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr!」

name: Synn
message: 「Will this do?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Thank you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuu~~. I wanna eat a beef bowl...\s06」
I'm starting to feel kind of bad for her.

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you want to eat one so badly?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm glad you asked! Back home, I've got three starving little ones waiting for me to return, sob, sob.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aren't there three of you……?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. 'Cause we're 'demons,' after all」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, speak of the devil, here comes Jangara!」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, it appeared!」

name: Sally
message: 「Look, he's starving, poor thing」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't really get it……」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm? What's wrong, Jangara」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat!? These guys are that 'Student Council'--!?」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Sally
message: 「I see, I see. Running into you here seals your fate」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean?」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't play dumb! You put my precious buddy through hell, didn't you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, right! I thought I'd seen this little guy somewhere, so it really is from back then……」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai, you know them?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's the demon from when we fought at the Five-Star Restaurant」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You can't even tell them apart」

name: Sally
message: 「Jangara! This is our big chance to settle the score from back then!」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Everyone, come on out!」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Sally
message: 「We are――」

name: Sally
message: 「The Delicious Food Squad♪」

name: Sally
message: 「We're gonna settle our food grudge once and for all----!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's an unfounded grudge, but if you're going to bare your fangs, we'll take you on. Ryuusei Crusaders, move out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--?! T-Transforming right here in the middle of town...?!」
